NFL quarterback rankings with item covariates

Source: R/paper_covariate_datasets.R
nfl_quarterbacks_2014.Rd

A faithful transcription of Tables 1 and 2 in Li, Yi and Liu (2022). It records the week-12, 2014 rankings of 24 quarterbacks by 13 experts and the 11 player statistics available before that week. Missing entries in ranking_positions mean that an expert did not include that player in the expert's top-24 list. Lower values are better ranks.

Usage

nfl_quarterbacks_2014()

Value

A list with ranking_positions (items by experts), item_covariates (items by covariates), and source metadata. The two tabular components share row names and can be used as a realistic fixture for future covariate-assisted ranking models.

Details

The source websites in the article are dynamic historical sports websites. Keeping this small, cited transcription makes the published example reproducible without presenting it as a live data download.

References

Li, X., Yi, D. and Liu, J. S. (2022). Bayesian analysis of rank data with covariates and heterogeneous rankers. Statistical Science, 37(1), 1–23. doi:10.1214/20-STS818
